details: Eurozone annual inflation accelerated to 3.3% in August, up from 2.9% in July, primarily driven by higher energy costs. This increase reinforces market expectations that the European Central Bank (ECB) will proceed with another interest rate hike next week, its second this year. Higher interest rates typically make speculative assets like cryptocurrencies less attractive due to increased borrowing costs.
title: Eurozone Inflation Jumps to 3.3%, ECB Rate Hike Expected

details: Broader crypto market gains are being held in check by persistent caution over potential US interest rate hikes, exacerbated by hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh. Simultaneously, renewed military tensions between the US and Iran are driving oil prices higher, fueling inflation fears, and contributing to a risk-off sentiment in financial markets, negatively impacting speculative assets such as Bitcoin.
title: US Rate Hike Bets & Iran Tensions Pressure Crypto Market

details: Financial markets are closely watching several key US job market reports due this week, as the strength of this data is critical for the Federal Reserve's September rate decision. Stronger-than-expected employment figures could reinforce the case for a rate hike, which typically pressures cryptocurrencies. Conversely, weaker data might revive hopes for rate cuts, potentially providing support for risk assets.
title: US Job Data This Week Critical for Fed Rate Decision & Crypto
